" Thumbelina" became the first animated film to be nominated for and win a Razzie, which it received for Worst Original Song. The list of nominees follows, with recipients denoted in bold.

The list of nominees follows, with recipients denoted in bold.  However, the ceremony was criticized for not nominating "Super Mario Bros." for any categories, including the post-predicted categories Worst Picture, Worst Screenplay and Worst Director, despite its critical and audience pan.
